title: ALMA Observations of Lyα Blob 1: Multiple Major Mergers and Widely Distributed Interstellar Media
question: What are the properties of the interstellar medium (dust, [C II], CO(4-3)), the phase of galaxy assembly, and the powering mechanisms of the extended Ly-alpha emission in the giant Lyman-alpha blob SSA22-LAB1 at z=3.1?

data.arrays: 12 m antennas (44-45 in Band 8; 38-39 and 45-46 in Band 7; 41-46 in Band 3)
data.angular_resolution: Band 8 & 7: 0.8", 1.0", and 1.4" images/cubes; Band 3: 1.53" x 1.30" (cube) and 1.61" x 1.39" (continuum)
data.sensitivity: Band 8 [C II]: 0.50 mJy/beam (0.8", 20 km/s), 0.30 mJy/beam (1.0", 80 km/s), 0.39 mJy/beam (1.4", 80 km/s); Band 8 cont: 52 uJy/beam; Band 7 cont: 11, 12, 16 uJy/beam (0.8", 1.0", 1.4"); Band 3 CO(4-3): 0.70 uJy/beam (80 km/s); Band 3 cont: 4.9 uJy

what.value: Deboosted SCUBA2 850 um flux measurement of LAB1 (S_850 = 3.6 +- 1.2 mJy)

evidence.quote: The updated ALMA-based flux is found to fall in the range of deboosted SCUBA2 measurements ($S_{850}=3.6\pm1.2$ mJy, (cite: 2017MNRAS.465.1789G)).

what.value: SED templates of ALESS SMGs used to scale 860 um fluxes to L_IR and SFR_IR

evidence.quote: IR luminosity ($L_{\rm IR}$) and IR-based SFR (SFR$_{\rm IR}$) were estimated, scaled 860 $\mu$m fluxes using SED templates of ALESS SMGs ((cite: 2017ApJ...840...78D)) (for more details, see (cite: 2018PASJ...70...65U)).

external_data.citation: Danielson et al. 2017 (cite: 2017ApJ...840...78D), Umehata et al. 2018 (cite: 2018PASJ...70...65U)

what.value: Brightness temperature ratio r_41 = 0.61 +- 0.13 and CO-to-H2 conversion factor alpha_CO = 3.6 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 from ASPECS

evidence.quote: Hence we adopt the brightness temperature ratio $r_{41}=0.61\pm0.13$, which is derived for the $z>2$ ASPECS galaxies, and $\alpha_{\rm CO}=3.6$ $M_\odot$ (K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$)$^{-1}$, which is adopted for the galaxies ((cite: 2020ApJ...902..110D)).

external_data.citation: Boogaard et al. 2020 (cite: 2020ApJ...902..109B), Decarli et al. 2020 (cite: 2020ApJ...902..110D)

what.value: Sum of stellar masses of the four massive galaxies with Ks-band counterparts (M_* approx 2.2 x 10^11 M_sun)

evidence.quote: The sum of the stellar masses of the four galaxies (i.e., the most massive four members) is estimated to be $M_*\approx2.2\times10^{11}$ $M_\odot$ (e.g., (cite: 2016MNRAS.455.3333K)).

recipe.goal: Decompose dust continuum sources and measure multi-band continuum fluxes
recipe.method: Sequentially model and subtract bright sources on the image plane using CASA imfit on 860 um (0.8" and 1.0") and 656 um images; measure total complex flux above 3 sigma.
key_parameters: 3 sigma threshold for total complex flux measurement

recipe.goal: Create 3D rendered [C II] cube, moment maps, and position-velocity diagrams
recipe.method: Extract voxels above 2 sigma per channel (before primary beam correction) from the naturally weighted 0.8" [C II] cube, keep only voxels connected in velocity space, apply primary beam correction, and compute moment 0, 1, 2 maps with casa/immoments; extract PV diagrams along 0.9" pseudo-slits.
key_parameters: 2 sigma voxel threshold connected in velocity space; 0.9" pseudo-slit width

recipe.goal: Extract [C II] and CO(4-3) spectra and measure line properties and sizes
recipe.method: Extract spectra at 1.4" resolution for groups (ALMA1+2+5, ALMA3, ALMA4) and at 1.0" resolution (d=1" apertures) for individual sources (ALMA1-ALMA7); fit single Gaussian profiles to derive redshift, FWHM, and velocity-integrated flux; measure deconvolved sizes on velocity-integrated maps using casa/imfit.
key_parameters: d = 1" aperture for 1.0" resolution individual source extraction; 320 km/s assumed velocity width for 3 sigma CO(4-3) upper limit on ALMA4
assumptions: Cosmology: Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7, H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1

recipe.goal: Derive physical ISM properties (L_IR, SFR_IR, M_dust, L_CO, M_gas, and resolved L_[CII]/L_IR)
recipe.method: Scale 860 um fluxes to L_IR and SFR_IR using ALESS SMG SED templates; compute dust mass assuming modified blackbody; compute CO(4-3) luminosity and convert to molecular gas mass; construct resolved 1.0" L_[CII]/L_IR vs Sigma_L_IR maps.
assumptions: Modified blackbody radiation with beta = 1.8 and T_d = 40 K for dust mass
Chabrier IMF and ALESS SMG SED templates for L_IR and SFR_IR
Brightness temperature ratio r_41 = 0.61 +- 0.13 and CO-to-H2 conversion factor alpha_CO = 3.6 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1

recipe.goal: Evaluate halo dynamics and Ly-alpha powering budget
recipe.method: Compare galaxy velocity offsets and projected separations from ALMA1 against NFW halo escape velocity tracks; measure rest-frame UV flux from R-band image inside [C II] apertures to compute SFR_UV and required Ly-alpha escape fraction under Case-B recombination.
key_parameters: NFW concentration c = 4.5; projection factors 2/pi (distance) and 1/sqrt(3) (velocity)
assumptions: NFW mass profile with spherical geometry; Case-B recombination and Chabrier IMF for UV SFR and Ly-alpha luminosity

answer_key.quantity: Total molecular gas mass in LAB1 (M_mol)

evidence.quote: LAB1 is found to harbour a total molecular gas mass $M_{\rm mol}=(8.7\pm2.0) \times 10^{10}$ M$_\odot$, concentrated in the core region of the Ly $\alpha$-emitting area.

answer_key.quantity: Integrated 860 um continuum flux of all components (1.4" map)

evidence.quote: The integrated flux of all components is $S_{860}= 2.66 \pm 0.11$ mJy in the 1.4$^{\prime\prime}$ map (Table \[table:ism\]).

answer_key.quantity: Total IR+UV star formation rate in LAB1

evidence.loc: The central heating source and scattering scenario
evidence.quote: The inferred SFR from this is SFR$_{\rm UV} \approx90$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$ following the equation SFR$_{\rm UV}$ \[M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$\]$=L_\nu \times (1.46\times10^{21})^{-1}$ \[W Hz$^{-1}$\] (for the Chabrier IMF, (cite: 1998ARA&A..36..189K); (cite: 2007ApJS..173..267S)), and so total UV+IR SFR is $\sim$ 300 M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$.

not_stated_but_needed: Exact uv-taper values (in arcsec or klambdas) used to produce the 1.0" and 1.4" Band 8 cubes and the 1.4" Band 7 continuum image
Cell (pixel) size and image dimensions (imsize) used in tclean for all bands
Deconvolver algorithm in tclean (e.g., hogbom, clark, multiscale)
Polynomial order and exact frequency/channel ranges used for continuum subtraction with imcontsub in Band 8 and Band 3
Dust mass opacity coefficient kappa_nu assumed when deriving M_dust^850 from modified blackbody at T_d=40 K and beta=1.8
Exact aperture coordinates and dimensions used to extract the 1.4" CO(4-3) and [C II] spectra for ALMA1+2+5, ALMA3, and ALMA4
missing_for_reproduction: Exact uv-tapering parameters used in tclean to generate the 1.0" and 1.4" cubes/images
Exact spatial masks used during tclean and exact irregular aperture polygons (shown in Fig. 2) used to extract the 1.4" group spectra
Dust mass opacity coefficient kappa_nu used to compute M_dust^850
Calibrated optical/NIR images from Subaru and HST (shared privately with the authors)
score_reason: All 6 ALMA project codes, CASA calibration/imaging versions, calibrators, weightings, beam sizes, and rms levels are clearly stated, and numeric results are well tabulated; however, exact uv-tapering values, pixel/image sizes, custom extraction aperture definitions, and dust opacity constants are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: All ALMA datasets are public in the archive with explicit project codes, the core analysis uses standard CASA tasks (tclean, imcontsub, immoments, imfit) and 1D Gaussian fits, and the primary continuum, line flux, redshift, and gas mass measurements are clearly tabulated in Tables 1-3.
